title: Open Terminal and Run a Command
trigger: User needs to run shell commands for the project

steps.action: Press Ctrl+` (backtick under Escape) to show the terminal band at the bottom
The terminal appears in the cluster's project folder; if multiple terminals exist, tabs show on the left
Press Ctrl+Shift+` to open a new terminal, or click the + on the terminal band
Type a command at the prompt and press Enter; output appears in the terminal
Press Ctrl+` again to hide the terminal band, or continue working while keeping it visible

outcome: A terminal is open in the cluster's project folder, ready to accept commands
